title: Implementing IoT sensors for HVAC efficiency: Best practices?

bodyHtml: We are currently looking to retrofit a 15- year-old commercial building with modern IoT sensors to better manage our HVAC load during peak hours. Has anyone successfully implemented a system that integrates smoothly with legacy BMS? Looking for recommendations on vendors that balance cost with reliability.
